authentication.signInDescription: Use your Pressly operator account. Your session stays in a protected browser cookie.
authentication.verifyDescription: Complete the server-held challenge to open the production workspace.
authentication.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again to continue.
authentication.accessNotAssignedDescription: {{name}} is authenticated, but this workspace is limited to owners, managers, and production operators.

errors.invalidCredentials: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.rateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts were made. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
errors.invalidMfaCode: That verification code is incorrect. Enter the current code and try again.
errors.expiredMfaChallenge: This verification attempt expired. Return to sign in and start again.
errors.unavailable: Processor cannot reach the sign-in service. Check your connection and try again.
errors.invalidResponse: The sign-in service returned an unreadable response. Reload Processor before trying again.
errors.forbidden: This account is not allowed to open Processor.
errors.loginFailed: Processor could not sign you in. Check your details and connection, then try again.
errors.verificationFailed: Processor could not verify this code. Return to sign in if the challenge has expired.
errors.restoreFailed: Processor could not restore your session. Sign in again to continue.
errors.logoutFailed: Processor could not confirm that you were signed out. Check your connection and try again.
